note.en: A blue-grey deepwater cod of the continental slope (350 to 3000 m) known here from a deep-sea record only.
note.es: Un bacalao gris azulado de aguas profundas del talud continental (350 a 3000 m) conocido aquí solo por un registro de aguas profundas.

recWhy: No record on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in the file (general range or Costa Rica only).
